translated_title: Sheinbaum Says the Fobaproa Debt Costs 50 Billion Pesos Every Two Years to the Public Budget
original_title: Sheinbaum afirma que deuda del Fobaproa cuesta 50 mil mdp cada dos años al presupuesto público
author: La Redacción
meta_description: In Colima, Sheinbaum tied the never-ending Fobaproa bill to Zedillo's 1990s bank rescue, when indebted farmers lost tractors and homes and many were pushed to migrate north.
